title: Music 2.6
description: MiniMax Music 2.6 — full-length songs from a style prompt and/or your own lyrics. Lyrics optimizer can write or polish lyrics from the prompt; instrumental mode skips vocals. MP3 or WAV output.

format.description: Output audio format. Defaults to wav (lossless); choose mp3 for a smaller file.

lyrics.description: Lyrics to sing (1-3500 characters). Required unless instrumental is true or lyrics_optimizer is true (the optimizer writes lyrics from the prompt).

lyrics_optimizer.description: Let the model write or polish lyrics from the prompt. Default true.

prompt.description: Style/mood description of the track (up to 2000 characters). Optional when lyrics are provided.
